dimensions.question: Can a newcomer tell what a change does to Paseo and why the fork needed it?
Do issues and pull requests say plainly what was tested, what was skipped and what still depends on upstream?
Does the change stay small enough to sync with upstream or to send upstream as its own pull request?
Are keys, host passwords and private paths kept out of the repository and out of issue text?

decision_rule: human review plus deterministic repository gates
